newsitem.title: GERMANY: Springer sells share in DSF sports TV.
newsitem.headline: Springer sells share in DSF sports TV.

text.p: German media group Axel Springer Verlag AG said on Thursday it would sell its share of sports television station DSF to partner Taurus Vermoegensverwaltungs GmbH.
The move gives Taurus, a unit of the Kirch Group, a 24.9 percent share of DSF.

DSF partners Rete Invest Holding S.A. and Rincovision AG have already agreed the transaction, Springer said. It is still subject to review by Germany's cartel office and the Bavarian office for new media.
Springer did not diclose the value of the transaction.
The sale would allow Springer to concentrate on its stakes in digital TV broadcaster Satellitenfernsehen GmbH and local broadcaster Hamburg 1.
Earlier this year, Kirch launched DF1, a satellite television venture offering 19 channels. The media group also plans to launch a Spanish satellite television venture with Spain's Telefonica.
